prior_credit: Historical source: J. Rives Childs. Published period key: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and Lasry's 2017 key list. Earlier repository OCR is preserved. Conditional partial reading and exact coordinate accounting: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.
limits: The 75-slot gap is conditioned on the advertised 220 length and the printed missing-groups note after the first ten received coordinates.
The 77 fixed positions of the edited layer include explicitly proposed lexical fills; only 37 positions are fixed before fills.
No complete plaintext, unique historical corruption mechanism or new global key/numeral assignment is asserted.
SZEGED, WEITERE ZUEGE VOM ALPEN, ABGEFAHREN and DIV ST ?U are priced lexical proposals, not independent received copies.
ALPEN???? and every other unresolved position remain literal; ALPENKORPS, ZU and IN are not supplied.
